Introduction
Admission Inquiry Placement Training & Placement Cell ABOUT Training & Placement Career Development Overview The Training & Development cell is to empower students to achieve their career aspirations by providing them with the necessary support, guidance, and resources. The Centre is committed to promoting a culture of lifelong learning and to helping students acquire the skills and knowledge needed to succeed in a rapidly changing job market.
